attributes.title: AORN Global Surgical Conference & Expo 2027
attributes.summary:
The 2027 AORN Global Surgical Conference & Expo takes place April 10 to 13, 2027, in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. It is the national meeting of perioperative nurses, combining accredited education sessions with a large surgical products exhibit hall.

AORN describes the program as offering accredited learning, but the number of contact hours, registration fees and the convention venue have not been published yet. A student program with complimentary access is planned. We will add credits and prices once AORN releases them.
